closed_items.title: Pi hosted La Nasa viewer survives a tunnel restart without a live VNC session
closed_items.evidence: 2026-08-28 live rpi3-view: xtigervncviewer had run since the graphical session began, while operium-hosted-nasa-tunnel.service had restarted later. The tunnel listener 127.0.0.1:5902 was present but ss showed no established VNC client connection, and Fracta 2 had no recent Pi VNC session. The viewer could therefore remain fullscreen yet stale after tunnel recovery. Fixed 2026-08-28 with operium-hosted-nasa-viewer.service (PartOf/After the tunnel); one service-managed xtigervncviewer and one ESTABLISHED loopback VNC session were verified after removing the obsolete in-memory desktop loop and after a clean Pi reboot. Physical observation then showed the Pi still displayed an empty desktop: the service process ran outside the labwc graphical session and did not prove a mapped window. The native VNC autostart was then removed. A clean Pi reboot started normal-window Firefox at the local NASA URL, and the operator confirmed La Nasa was visible.
closed_items.next_action: Native RFB is intentionally not the active projection. Track any KasmVNC Remote Web Session experiment in Operium issue #24, preserving Firefox local as the validated baseline.
